events.description: Walk outdoors at an easy, comfortable pace for 10 minutes.

series.description: Warm up in the gym with 2 minutes of easy walking and gentle shoulder movements.
For the next 3 minutes, do 2 sets of 5 sit-to-stands from a stable bench. Stand slowly and sit with control; rest between sets and for any remaining time.
For the next 3 minutes, do 2 sets of 5 wall push-ups. Keep your body straight and move slowly; rest between sets and for any remaining time.
Finish with 2 minutes of easy walking and relaxed breathing.
